description: Source file implementing classes and functions for extracting and handling debug information from DWARF data, including line info and function info handlers.

classes.name: CULineInfoHandler
classes.description: Handles line information for source files, defining directories, files, and adding line mappings.

classes.name: CUFunctionInfoHandler
classes.description: Handles function information within DWARF debugging data, including starting compilation units, DIEs, and processing attributes.

methods.name: DefineDir
methods.description: Defines a directory name associated with a directory number.

methods.name: DefineFile
methods.description: Defines a source file with its name, directory, modification time, and length.

methods.name: AddLine
methods.description: Adds a line number mapping for a specific address in a source file.

methods.name: StartCompilationUnit
methods.description: Initializes processing for a compilation unit in DWARF data.

methods.name: StartDIE
methods.description: Begins processing a Debugging Information Entry (DIE) for functions or compile units.

methods.name: ProcessAttributeString
methods.description: Processes string attributes of a DIE, such as function names.

methods.name: ProcessAttributeUnsigned
methods.description: Processes unsigned attributes of a DIE, such as low/high PC, line, and file.

methods.name: ProcessAttributeReference
methods.description: Processes reference attributes of a DIE, such as function specifications.

methods.name: EndDIE
methods.description: Finalizes processing of a DIE, inserting function info into address maps.
